blocks.text: MABALACAT CITY — The Central Luzon police have prohibited drones from flying over the Clark Freeport Zone in Pampanga and the Subic Bay Freeport Zone during the 49th Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) Summit from Nov15 to 18. The ban covers recreational, commercial, and other unauthorized drone flights during the summit period, said Brigadier General Jess Mendez, Region 3 police director and commander of the 2026 ASEAN Summit’s Special Task Group Central Luzon. “We urge all drone operators and hobbyists to strictly observe the no-fly restriction.
